select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'd360' and table_name = 'DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_CI_LOAD'

select distinct TRANSACTION_DATE from [d360].[DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_CI_LOAD] order by 1

select MAX(TRAN_DATE) DATES from [EDS].[DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE] order by 1

DECLARE @YRMO_DATE DATE
SET @YRMO_DATE = '2023-09-01'
INSERT INTO [d360].[DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_CI_LOAD] (ACID,TRANSACTION_ID,TRANSACTION_SERIAL_NUMBER,TRANSACTION_DATE,TRANSACTION_CURRENCY_CODE,TRANSACTION_AMOUNT,TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP,INITIALIZING_BRANCH_CODE,TRANSACTION_TYPE,BRANCH_CODE,SOURCE_CODE,TRANSACTION_PARTICULAR,TRANSACTION_REMARKS,CHANGED_TIME,CREATED_TIME,POSTED_DATE,BANK_ID,FCBSCIF)
SELECT
     HTD.ACID
    ,HTD.TRAN_ID
    ,HTD.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM
    ,HTD.TRAN_DATE
    ,HTD.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE
    ,HTD.TRAN_AMT
    ,HTD.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP 
    ,HTD.DTH_INIT_SOL_ID
    ,HTD.PART_TRAN_TYPE
    ,HTD.SOL_ID
    ,HTD.SOURCE_CODE
    ,HTD.TRAN_PARTICULAR
    ,HTD.TRAN_RMKS
    ,HTD.LCHG_TIME
    ,HTD.RCRE_TIME
    ,HTD.PSTD_DATE
    ,HTD.BANK_ID
    ,DAC.ORGKEY AS FCBSCIF
    FROM (
        SELECT
         HTD.ACID
        ,HTD.TRAN_ID
        ,HTD.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM
        ,HTD.TRAN_DATE
        ,HTD.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE
        ,HTD.TRAN_AMT
        ,CASE WHEN HTD.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN HTD.TRAN_AMT 
            ELSE HTD.TRAN_AMT * CC.ConversionRate END AS TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP
        --,1 TRAN_CNT
        ,HTD.DTH_INIT_SOL_ID
        ,HTD.PART_TRAN_TYPE
        ,HTD.SOL_ID
        ,HTD.SOURCE_CODE
        ,HTD.TRAN_PARTICULAR
        ,HTD.TRAN_RMKS
        ,HTD.LCHG_TIME
        ,HTD.RCRE_TIME
        ,HTD.PSTD_DATE
        ,HTD.BANK_ID
        ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY HTD.ACID, HTD.TRAN_ID, HTD.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM, HTD.TRAN_DATE  ORDER BY HTD.[FILE_NAME] DESC, HTD.INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN
        FROM [EDS].[DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE] HTD
        LEFT JOIN  (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CurrencyConversion where ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV') CC
            ON HTD.BANK_ID = CC.FinancialInstitutionId
            AND HTD.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId
            AND HTD.TRAN_DATE = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
        WHERE BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
        AND concat(right('0000'+convert(varchar,year(tran_date)),4), right('00'+convert(varchar,month(tran_date)),2) ) = concat(right('0000'+convert(varchar,year(@curr_date)),4), right('00'+convert(varchar,month(@curr_date)),2) )
        --TRAN_DATE BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-04-30'
    ) HTD
JOIN D360.DEP_AAS_CUSTDIM_hash DAC
    ON HTD.ACID = DAC.ACID
    AND HTD.TRAN_DATE = DAC.AS_OF_DATE
    AND HTD.BANK_ID = DAC.BANK_ID
WHERE HTD.RN = 1

select top 10 right('0000'+convert(varchar,year(tran_date)),4) yyyy, right('00'+convert(varchar,month(tran_date)),2) mm, 
concat(right('0000'+convert(varchar,year(tran_date)),4), right('00'+convert(varchar,month(tran_date)),2) ) yyyymm from [EDS].[DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE] HTD

insert into BUSC.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE (TRAN_DATE,TRAN_ID,PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM,DEL_FLG,TRAN_TYPE,TRAN_SUB_TYPE,PART_TRAN_TYPE,GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE,ACID,VALUE_DATE,TRAN_AMT,TRAN_PARTICULAR,ENTRY_USER_ID,PSTD_USER_ID,VFD_USER_ID,ENTRY_DATE,PSTD_DATE,VFD_DATE,RPT_CODE,REF_NUM,INSTRMNT_TYPE,INSTRMNT_DATE,INSTRMNT_NUM,INSTRMNT_ALPHA,TRAN_RMKS,PSTD_FLG,PRNT_ADVC_IND,AMT_RESERVATION_IND,RESERVATION_AMT,RESTRICT_MODIFY_IND,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,CUST_ID,VOUCHER_PRINT_FLG,MODULE_ID,BR_CODE,FX_TRAN_AMT,RATE_CODE,RATE,CRNCY_CODE,NAVIGATION_FLG,TRAN_CRNCY_CODE,REF_CRNCY_CODE,REF_AMT,SOL_ID,BANK_CODE,TREA_REF_NUM,TREA_RATE,TS_CNT,GST_UPD_FLG,ISO_FLG,EABFAB_UPD_FLG,LIFT_LIEN_FLG,PROXY_POST_IND,SI_SRL_NUM,SI_ORG_EXEC_DATE,PR_SRL_NUM,SERIAL_NUM,DEL_MEMO_PAD,UAD_MODULE_ID,UAD_MODULE_KEY,REVERSAL_DATE,REVERSAL_VALUE_DATE,PTTM_EVENT_TYPE,PROXY_ACID,TOD_ENTITY_TYPE,TOD_ENTITY_ID,DTH_INIT_SOL_ID,REGULARIZATION_AMT,PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT,TF_ENTITY_SOL_ID,TRAN_PARTICULAR_2,TRAN_PARTICULAR_CODE,TR_STATUS,SVS_TRAN_ID,CRNCY_HOL_CHK_DONE_FLG,REFERRAL_ID,PARTY_CODE,GL_DATE,BKDT_TRAN_FLG,BANK_ID,IMPL_CASH_PART_TRAN_FLG,PTRAN_CHRG_EXISTS_FLG,MUD_POOL_BAL_BUILD_FLG,USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT,USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN,USED_EMER_ADVN,GL_SEGMENT_STRING,COMB_TRAN_ID,SYS_PART_TRAN_CODE,USER_PART_TRAN_CODE,TRAN_FREE_CODE1,TRAN_FREE_CODE2,RESP_ACCT_REF_NO,PURPOSE_CODE,BNK_CODE,SOURCE_CODE,FILE_NAME,INSERT_DTTM,BUSINESSDATE)
SELECT TOP 1000
'2024-08-01' TRAN_DATE,TRAN_ID,PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM,DEL_FLG,TRAN_TYPE,TRAN_SUB_TYPE,PART_TRAN_TYPE,GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE,ACID,VALUE_DATE,TRAN_AMT,TRAN_PARTICULAR,ENTRY_USER_ID,PSTD_USER_ID,VFD_USER_ID,ENTRY_DATE,PSTD_DATE,VFD_DATE,RPT_CODE,REF_NUM,INSTRMNT_TYPE,INSTRMNT_DATE,INSTRMNT_NUM,INSTRMNT_ALPHA,TRAN_RMKS,PSTD_FLG,PRNT_ADVC_IND,AMT_RESERVATION_IND,RESERVATION_AMT,RESTRICT_MODIFY_IND,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,CUST_ID,VOUCHER_PRINT_FLG,MODULE_ID,BR_CODE,FX_TRAN_AMT,RATE_CODE,RATE,CRNCY_CODE,NAVIGATION_FLG,TRAN_CRNCY_CODE,REF_CRNCY_CODE,REF_AMT,SOL_ID,BANK_CODE,TREA_REF_NUM,TREA_RATE,TS_CNT,GST_UPD_FLG,ISO_FLG,EABFAB_UPD_FLG,LIFT_LIEN_FLG,PROXY_POST_IND,SI_SRL_NUM,SI_ORG_EXEC_DATE,PR_SRL_NUM,SERIAL_NUM,DEL_MEMO_PAD,UAD_MODULE_ID,UAD_MODULE_KEY,REVERSAL_DATE,REVERSAL_VALUE_DATE,PTTM_EVENT_TYPE,PROXY_ACID,TOD_ENTITY_TYPE,TOD_ENTITY_ID,DTH_INIT_SOL_ID,REGULARIZATION_AMT,PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT,TF_ENTITY_SOL_ID,TRAN_PARTICULAR_2,TRAN_PARTICULAR_CODE,TR_STATUS,SVS_TRAN_ID,CRNCY_HOL_CHK_DONE_FLG,REFERRAL_ID,PARTY_CODE,GL_DATE,BKDT_TRAN_FLG,BANK_ID,IMPL_CASH_PART_TRAN_FLG,PTRAN_CHRG_EXISTS_FLG,MUD_POOL_BAL_BUILD_FLG,USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT,USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN,USED_EMER_ADVN,GL_SEGMENT_STRING,COMB_TRAN_ID,SYS_PART_TRAN_CODE,USER_PART_TRAN_CODE,TRAN_FREE_CODE1,TRAN_FREE_CODE2,RESP_ACCT_REF_NO,PURPOSE_CODE,BNK_CODE,SOURCE_CODE,FILE_NAME,INSERT_DTTM,BUSINESSDATE
FROM BUSC.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE where tran_date = '2023-09-01'

select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'EDS' and table_name = 'DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE'
